### Task 2: Bigram Analysis

We investigated whether including bigrams (two-word combinations) improved binary webpage classification compared with using individual words alone. We converted the cleaned text into numerical features using TF-IDF and applied PCA to reduce the number of variables. We then fitted logistic regression models using word-based predictions, with and without additional bigram principal components. The word-only model achieved 77.1% accuracy on 428 validation webpages, compared with 77.1% for the model incorporating bigrams. Although adding bigrams changed 18 individual predictions, overall accuracy remained unchanged. These results suggest that bigrams did not provide additional predictive benefit under our current modeling approach.
